intent: Cluster test that leader handles misbehaving commands safely: unhandled exceptions return 500s without crashing, control-character exception messages are URL-encoded, and commands that crash the server cause a clean failover with the follower refusing the identical command.

objects.name: BadCommandTest::test
objects.role: runs the whole scenario, retried up to twice since crash-and-failover isn't guaranteed to land cleanly first try
